_comment: Component registry: the architecture's component set, as dist metadata. The installer carries this file VERBATIM into var/manifest.json (it authors nothing, maintains nothing). `dsys doctor` evaluates each component against the live tree and reports per-component status: instantiated | specified-only | absent | mutated. Artifact entries ending in '/' mean 'every manifest-covered file under this prefix'.

components.description: The judging package: schema, validators, verification views, golden run. Function is covered separately by doctor's golden_chain check; here 'instantiated' means present and pristine.
components.name: core

components.description: The dsys command surface: referee, doctor, state, derive, roles, scenario, session.
components.name: cli

components.description: Derivation executor: takes a DerivationManifest, returns release bytes plus a RunnerReceipt. Zero discretion; refusals are check results, not dispositions.
components.name: runner

components.description: Role bundles (cos, operator, auditor), versioned and seal-verified. Full profile only.
components.name: roles

components.description: Test-drive scenarios: declarative exercise specs, driver-interpreted. Full profile only.
components.name: scenarios

components.description: Authoring-and-building system producing AutomatonRelease candidates. Specified, not implemented.
components.name: factory

components.description: Third playbook: transcription as DoD conditionals (START/STOP/KEEP, T1-T4). Specified, not implemented.
components.name: transcription

components.description: Live run-book executor. The automaton plane is validated in golden runs; no executor is built, and the CLI deliberately offers no run-book addressee.
components.name: automaton-executor
components.spec: architecture doc (automaton plane); no executor spec yet

components.description: Branch-per-writer sync protocol. Specified; the CLI surface is a refusing stub and the hosted service is a separate build.
components.name: session-sync

components.description: File-based prompt-response transport backend for ambient inferencing. Exploratory; not approved for implementation.
components.name: dialog
